lessons.why: 6x7 and 7x6 counter-rotate (the ORDER is the rotation) -/ def lead_83b7cc65 : Prop := 6 * 7 ≠ 7 * 6 ∨ ((List.range 9).any (fun x => decide ((6 * (7 * x)) % 9 ≠ (7 * (6 * x)) % 9)) = true) /-- The kernel refutes lead 83b7cc65: 6x7 and 7x6 counter-rotate (the ORDER is the rotation).
